registry.title: FaceGaze Bridge 模块库
registry.description: FaceGaze Bridge 原生模块的公开索引，数据来自各模块自己的 GitHub Release。

modules.name: PICO Connect Face
modules.summary: PICO 4 Pro/Enterprise 面捕，直接读 PICO 互联的 UDP 数据，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 直接接收 PICO 互联（PICO Connect）发出的 UDP 面捕数据，输出 Unified Expressions 表情、睁眼度与逐眼方向。52 个 ARKit 系数映射到 58 个形状，不注入任何进程，也不需要管理员权限。
modules.usage: 1. 在 PICO 互联的 settings.json 中把 faceTrackingMode 设为 1、faceTrackingTransferProtocol 设为 2（旧版 VRCFT 用 1），改完重启 PICO 互联。2. 关闭 VRCFT：它和本模块抢同一个 UDP 端口。3. 在「模块」页把本模块设为启动并重启引擎；连接头显后模块卡片应显示活跃。

en.summary: PICO 4 Pro/Enterprise face tracking straight from PICO Connect over UDP — no VRCFT needed.
en.description: Reads the UDP face-tracking stream that PICO Connect already sends, and outputs Unified Expressions shapes plus eye openness and per-eye gaze. 52 ARKit coefficients map to 58 shapes. No process injection, no admin rights.
en.usage: 1. In PICO Connect's settings.json set faceTrackingMode to 1 and faceTrackingTransferProtocol to 2 (use 1 for the legacy VRCFT protocol), then restart PICO Connect. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking — it fights this module for the same UDP port. 3. Set the module as active on the Modules page and restart the engine; the card should turn active once the headset is connected.

modules.name: iFacialMocap
modules.summary: iFacialMocap（iPhone）面捕，直接读 UDP 文本流并自动回握手包，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 接收 iFacialMocap App 发到本机 49983 端口的 ASCII 数据报，输出 Unified Expressions 表情、睁眼度与逐眼方向。上游按镜像视角命名，`*_L` 对应我们的右侧，模块在写映射表之前先归一到统一口径；收到来源地址后会按协议回一次握手包。52 个 ARKit 系数走通用映射，眼动角度存在时用真实角度覆盖方向。不注入进程，也不需要管理员权限。**本模块为社区未验证实现**。
modules.usage: 1. iPhone 与 PC 在同一 WiFi，在 iFacialMocap 里填 PC 的局域网 IP，端口 49983。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking：它和本模块抢同一个端口。3. 在「模块」页把 iFacialMocap 设为启动并重启引擎；卡片应提示「已向 <IP> 回握手包」。4. 未验证：特别请确认真眨左眼时动的是哪一路的睁眼度，反了请提 issue。

en.summary: iFacialMocap (iPhone) over UDP, handshake included — no VRCFT needed.
en.description: Reads iFacialMocap's ASCII UDP stream on port 49983 and outputs Unified Expressions shapes, eye openness and per-eye gaze. The source names its shapes mirrored (`*_L` is our right side), so the module normalises that before mapping, and replies with the protocol handshake once a sender appears. 52 ARKit coefficients go through the shared table; real eye angles override the inferred direction when present. **Community-untested.**
en.usage: 1. Put the iPhone and PC on the same Wi-Fi and point iFacialMocap at this PC's LAN address (port 49983). 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking — same port. 3. Enable iFacialMocap as a startup instance and restart the engine; the card should report the handshake reply. 4. Untested: check which eye's openness moves when you blink your left eye, and file an issue if it's flipped.

modules.name: MeowFace
modules.summary: MeowFace 手机面捕，直接读它发出的 UDP JSON，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 直接接收 MeowFace App 发到本机 12345 端口的 UDP JSON，输出 Unified Expressions 表情、睁眼度与逐眼方向。49 个 ARKit 风格系数按通用表映射，MeowFace 特有的近似项（微笑同时喂 CheekSquint、Dimple 等）单独列出。不注入任何进程，也不需要管理员权限。**本模块为社区未验证实现**，真机验收仍在进行。
modules.usage: 1. 手机装好 MeowFace，在 App 里填这台 PC 的局域网 IP，端口默认 12345。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking：它和本模块抢同一个端口。3. 在「模块」页把 MeowFace 设为启动（角色 expression + eyes）并重启引擎。4. 未验证：请在 issue 里附手机型号、MeowFace 版本与现象，尤其是左右眼极化是否正确。

en.summary: MeowFace face tracking straight over UDP — no VRCFT needed.
en.description: Reads MeowFace's UDP JSON stream on port 12345 and outputs Unified Expressions shapes, eye openness and per-eye gaze. 49 ARKit-style coefficients go through the shared mapping table; MeowFace's own approximations are listed separately. No process injection, no admin rights. **Community-untested** — hardware acceptance is still pending.
en.usage: 1. Point MeowFace on your phone at this PC's LAN address (port 12345). 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking — it fights this module for the same port. 3. Set MeowFace as a startup instance (expression + eyes) and restart the engine. 4. Untested: please file an issue with phone model, MeowFace version and what you saw, especially left/right eye polarity.

modules.name: Steam Link
modules.summary: Steam Link 在 Meta Quest 上的眼动/面捕，直接读它转发的 OSC，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 接收本机 Steam Link PC 客户端转发的 OSC（UDP 9015，仅绑 127.0.0.1）。56 条 /sl/xrfb/facew 地址映射到 Unified Expressions；EyesClosedL/R 与 LidTightener 给睁眼度；/sl/eyeTrackedGazePoint 是 **3 float 的三维注视点**（不是 2D 屏幕点），归一化成 -Z 前的方向射线，因此从不置 FGB_ATTR_POINT_VIEWPORT。Valve 未公开该协议，字段来自逆向，且「分包」表现为多个各自完整可解析的 bundle，靠跨包逐地址累积重组。
modules.usage: 1. Steam Link 里启用眼动/面捕并允许 VRCFT 数据格式。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking（同端口）。3. 在「模块」页设为启动，渲染注视给 gaze、头像眼睛给 eyes。4. 未验证：注视点的绝对坐标系与单位、facew 值域、facec 语义与 Tongue 扩展均需真机确认。

en.summary: Steam Link eye and face tracking on Meta Quest, read straight from its OSC forwarder.
en.description: Reads OSC forwarded by the local Steam Link PC client (UDP 9015, bound to 127.0.0.1 only). 56 /sl/xrfb/facew addresses map onto Unified Expressions; EyesClosedL/R plus LidTightener drive openness; /sl/eyeTrackedGazePoint turns out to be a **3-float 3D gaze point**, not a 2D screen point, so it is normalised into a -Z-forward ray and FGB_ATTR_POINT_VIEWPORT is never set. Valve documents none of this: the fields are reverse-engineered, and 'splitting' arrives as several independently parseable bundles reassembled per address.
en.usage: 1. In Steam Link enable eye/face tracking and allow the VRCFT data format. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking (same port). 3. Enable the module; give gaze to the render channel and eyes to the avatar. 4. Untested: the gaze point's absolute frame and units, the facew value range, facec semantics and the Tongue extension all need hardware verification.

modules.name: Virtual Desktop
modules.summary: Virtual Desktop 串流的面捕，直接读它写的共享内存 BodyState，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 读 VirtualDesktop.BodyState 与同名事件（裸名按 .NET OpenFileMapping 实际行为确认，未自造 Local\ 前缀）。FaceState 360 字节、既无版本号也无计数前缀，故用双快照比对防半更新，映射长度先校验、越界读拒绝且不部分写出。bit0 门控 70 权重→69 个 Unified 形状；眼 valid 时由双眼 Pose 出注视。上游无数据时把瞳孔伪造成 5mm，本模块不写瞳孔。
modules.usage: 1. VD 串流端 ≥1.30 开启面部转发、头显启用面捕。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking。3. 设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：眼 Pose 坐标系、FaceFlags 高位、置信度语义。

en.summary: Virtual Desktop face tracking read straight from its BodyState shared memory — no VRCFT.
en.description: Consumes the VirtualDesktop.BodyState mapping and event (bare names confirmed against .NET's OpenFileMapping behaviour, no invented prefix). FaceState is 360 bytes with neither version nor counter, so two-snapshot comparison guards torn reads and lengths are validated before reading. bit0 gates 70 weights onto 69 shapes; per-eye gaze comes from the poses when valid. Pupil is deliberately not written because upstream fakes 5mm.
en.usage: 1. VD Streamer 1.30+ with face forwarding on. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking. 3. Enable the module and restart the engine. 4. Untested: pose frame, high FaceFlags bits, confidence semantics.

modules.name: ALVR
modules.summary: ALVR 串流的 Quest 眼动/面捕，直接读它发出的 UDP 追踪包，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 接收 ALVR 服务端按 VRCFT 兼容格式发到本机 41463 端口的追踪包：8 字节前缀 + 小端 float 数组（EyesQuat / CombQuat / Face2Fb / FacePico / EyesHtc / LipHtc）。字段长度与含义按 ALVR 发送端源码逐项核对，与老接收端不一致的地方（FacePico 实为 52 项、接收端按 72 读）以发送端为准，多余字节不猜、不伪造。不注入进程，也不需要管理员权限。
modules.usage: 1. ALVR 服务端设置里把 Eye and face tracking 设为 VRCFaceTracking。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking：它和本模块抢同一个 UDP 端口。3. 在「模块」页把 ALVR 设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：真机极化与平滑未逐项比对，异常请附 ALVR 版本与头显型号。

en.summary: ALVR eye/face tracking straight over UDP — no VRCFT needed.
en.description: Reads ALVR server's VRCFT-compatible packets on port 41463: an 8-byte ASCII prefix followed by little-endian floats (EyesQuat / CombQuat / Face2Fb / FacePico / EyesHtc / LipHtc). Field lengths were checked against ALVR's sending side, so where the older receiver disagrees (FacePico is 52 values, the receiver reads 72) this follows the sender and never invents the extra bytes. No injection, no admin rights.
en.usage: 1. In ALVR's settings set Eye and face tracking to VRCFaceTracking. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking — it uses the same UDP port. 3. Enable ALVR as a startup instance and restart the engine. 4. Untested: eye polarity and smoothing aren't device-verified; include your ALVR version and headset when reporting issues.

modules.name: ALXR (OpenXR Local)
modules.summary: ALXR 本地模式：自建 headless OpenXR 会话读 FB/HTC/EXT 面捕扩展，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 通过 libalxr 的 C ABI 建无窗口 OpenXR 会话，读当前运行时的面部/眼动扩展。厂商与第三方头文件不入库，只声明最小原型并注明依据版本、运行时动态加载；CI 在无 SDK 环境下靠适配层 stub 构建测试。未确认字段不置属性位。
modules.usage: 1. 需要可用 OpenXR 运行时与 ALXR 串流端。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking。3. 设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：扩展可用性、真机极化。

en.summary: ALXR local mode: a headless OpenXR session reading FB/HTC/EXT face extensions — no VRCFT.
en.description: Builds a windowless OpenXR session through libalxr's C ABI and reads the active runtime's face and eye extensions. No vendor or third-party headers are vendored, only minimal prototypes with their reference version loaded at runtime, and CI builds against an adapter stub where no SDK exists. Unconfirmed fields never set attribute bits.
en.usage: 1. Needs a working OpenXR runtime and an ALXR client. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking. 3. Enable the module and restart the engine. 4. Untested: extension availability, on-hardware polarity.

modules.name: ALXR (OpenXR Remote)
modules.summary: ALXR 远程模式：TCP 连串流客户端收 ALXRFacialEyePacket，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 连接客户端 TCP 49192，解析 Pack=1 的 ALXRFacialEyePacket（字节头 + 70 个 float + 两个 XrPosef）。字段顺序、字节序与 pose 布局按上游一手核对，未确认项在 docs/protocol.md 标注；无效帧不置属性位，断线重连带退避与限频告警。与 Local 同仓库、两个独立产物与清单。
modules.usage: 1. 串流端启用 ALXR 并允许面部数据。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking。3. 设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：真机极化、部分权重语义。

en.summary: ALXR remote mode: connects to the streaming client over TCP and parses ALXRFacialEyePacket — no VRCFT.
en.description: Connects to the client's TCP 49192 and parses Pack=1 ALXRFacialEyePacket (byte header, 70 floats, two XrPosef). Order, byte order and pose layout were checked first-hand upstream, with unconfirmed items flagged; invalid frames set no attribute bits and reconnection uses backoff. Ships alongside Local as two independent products in one repository.
en.usage: 1. Enable ALXR on the streaming side and allow face data. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking. 3. Enable the module and restart the engine. 4. Untested: polarity, some weight semantics.

modules.name: Bigscreen Beyond
modules.summary: Bigscreen Beyond 眼追，读官方眼动应用写的 VRCFT 兼容共享内存，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 结构按 pack 8 共 64 字节：9 个 float 的双眼/合成方向、Confidence、int64 时间戳、int32 IsValid、左右闭眼量。该格式无官方文档、属社区逆向，字段语义与各实现间分歧都写进 docs/protocol.md 并逐项标注。IsValid≠1 时零输出、绝不伪造 (0,0,-1)；置信度不参与「写不写」的裁决，只有 IsValid 参与。
modules.usage: 1. 装 Bigscreen 官方眼追应用并勾选 VRCFT 接收。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking。3. 设为启动，gaze 给渲染、eyes 给头像。4. 未验证：z 符号、时间戳基准、Confidence 量程。

en.summary: Bigscreen Beyond eye tracking via the VRCFT-compatible memory its official app writes — no VRCFT.
en.description: A 64-byte pack-8 layout: nine floats of direction, confidence, int64 timestamp, int32 IsValid and per-eye closure. There is no official spec — this is community reverse engineering, so meanings and disagreements between implementations are recorded per item. Nothing is emitted unless IsValid is 1, and only IsValid decides emission, never confidence.
en.usage: 1. Install Bigscreen's eye-tracking app and tick the VRCFT receiver. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking. 3. Enable the module. 4. Untested: z sign, timestamp clock base, confidence range.

modules.name: Cymple Face Tracking
modules.summary: Project Cymple 面捕/眼追的定长 UDP 包，直接解析，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 接收 Project Cymple 发到本机 22999 端口的 292 字节定长包（魔数 0xFFFFFFFD 小端 + 大端 Flags + msgType/payloadSize + 70 个小端 float）。魔数、msgType、payloadSize 与字节序逐项校验，任一不符整包拒收，不做「猜一个能解出来的解释」。嘴/眼两个域位各自决定这一帧声明哪些通道，域位没亮就不提交那一路。眼动 Pitch/Yaw 经核对是 [-1,1] 归一值而非角度；瞳孔只写 dilation，因 0 的语义与毫米换算未确认。
modules.usage: 1. 在 Cymple 发送端把目标 IP 设为本机、端口 22999。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking 避免抢端口。3. 在「模块」页设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：极化真机方向、瞳孔 0 的语义、Flags 其余位含义；发送端序列化源码未公开，结论靠接收端与第三方实现交叉核对。

en.summary: Project Cymple face and eye tracking from its fixed-size UDP packet — no VRCFT needed.
en.description: Reads Project Cymple's 292-byte fixed packet on port 22999 (little-endian magic 0xFFFFFFFD, big-endian flags, msgType/payloadSize, then 70 little-endian floats). Magic, msgType, payload size and byte order are all validated and any mismatch rejects the whole packet rather than guessing a decodable interpretation. The mouth and eye domain flags independently decide which channels the frame declares, so an unlit flag never submits data. Eye pitch/yaw turned out to be normalised [-1,1] values, not degrees; pupil writes dilation only, since the meaning of 0 and any millimetre conversion are unconfirmed.
en.usage: 1. Point Cymple's sender at this PC on port 22999. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking (same port). 3. Enable the module and restart the engine. 4. Untested: on-hardware polarity, what pupil 0 means, and the remaining flag bits. The sender's serialiser isn't public, so conclusions come from the receiver and a third-party implementation.

modules.name: EyeTrackVR
modules.summary: EyeTrackVR 自制眼追的 OSC 输出，直接进 eyes / gaze 通道，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 接收 EyeTrackVR 的 OSC 数据（默认监听 8889）。眼动单位是 VRCFT 的归一化 tan 空间（+x 右、+y 上，±1 为标定 FOV 边缘），不是角度；openness 由来源直接给出，不做 1-blink 反推。只声明真正确认能填的通道：表情是模拟值、头姿与视口标定都没有，所以都不声明；某字段这帧没收到就不置属性位，绝不伪造正前方。含与上游参数一致的 1€ 滤波。
modules.usage: 1. 在 EyeTrackVR 里把 OSC 输出目标设为本机 IP，端口 8889（VRCFT 默认发 9000，需对齐）。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking。3. 在「模块」页设为启动，渲染注视角色给 gaze，头像眼睛给 eyes。4. 未验证：±1 对应的真实标定半角、V1 双眼共享 Y 在快速垂直眼动下的表现均需确认。

en.summary: EyeTrackVR open-source eye tracking over OSC, feeding the eyes and gaze channels.
en.description: Reads EyeTrackVR's OSC stream (listens on 8889 by default). Angles arrive in VRCFT's normalised tan space (+x right, +y up, ±1 at the calibration FOV edge), not degrees, and openness comes from the source directly rather than as 1-blink. Only channels this module can genuinely fill are declared — simulated expressions, head pose and viewport calibration are not. A field absent from a packet leaves its attribute unset instead of faking forward gaze. Includes a 1€ filter matching upstream parameters.
en.usage: 1. Point EyeTrackVR's OSC output at this PC on port 8889 (it defaults to 9000, so align them). 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking. 3. Enable the module; assign gaze to the render channel and eyes to the avatar. 4. Untested: what ±1 maps to in your calibration, and V1's shared vertical value under fast eye movement, both need verification.

modules.name: FoxyFace
modules.summary: 用摄像头面捕的 FoxyFace，直接读它的 UDP JSON 输出，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 接收 FoxyFace 的 VRCFT 输出（UDP JSON，默认 127.0.0.1:25747）。它的键名就是 Unified Expressions 形状名，模块按名向宿主查下标后直接写入，不硬编码顺序；未知键跳过并计数。能识别 FoxyFace 空闲时发的 PingPacket 心跳，不会把它当成表情数据，也不会误判成断流。Head* 字段单位未确认，本期不接入。
modules.usage: 1. 在 FoxyFace 的 VRCFT 输出里把目标填 127.0.0.1、端口 25747（它靠监听 57130 广播自动发现，FaceGaze Bridge 不广播，所以要手填）。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking 避免抢端口。3. 在「模块」页设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：EyeX/EyeY 的值域上限与极化仍需真机确认。

en.summary: FoxyFace webcam tracking over UDP JSON — no VRCFT needed.
en.description: Reads FoxyFace's VRCFT output (UDP JSON, 127.0.0.1:25747 by default). Its keys already are Unified Expressions shape names, so the module resolves them by name instead of hardcoding order, and unknown keys are counted and skipped. FoxyFace's idle PingPacket heartbeat is recognised — it neither becomes expression data nor a false stall. Head* fields are parsed but not emitted because their units are unconfirmed.
en.usage: 1. Set FoxyFace's VRCFT target to 127.0.0.1 port 25747 manually — it auto-discovers via a 57130 broadcast listener, and FaceGaze Bridge does not broadcast. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking (same port). 3. Enable the module and restart the engine. 4. Untested: EyeX/EyeY range and polarity still need hardware checks.

modules.name: LiveLink
modules.summary: Unreal LiveLink Face（iPhone）面捕，直接读 UDP 大端 float，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 接收 LiveLink Face App 发到本机 11111 端口的数据报，取包尾 244 字节按大端解出 float 序列，映射成 Unified Expressions 表情、睁眼度与逐眼方向。字段名表按上游顺序建立，识别数不符时整帧拒绝并在日志里说明，不会字段错位后静默输出错表情；变长包头、截断包与 NaN 都有明确处理。眼动角度字段存在时用真实角度覆盖方向（置信度 0.85）。头姿已解析但本期不输出（单位与轴向未确认）。**本模块为社区未验证实现**。
modules.usage: 1. iPhone 上用 Unreal LiveLink Face App，把 PC 的局域网 IP 填进去（端口 11111）。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking：它和本模块抢同一个端口。3. 在「模块」页把 LiveLink 设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：头姿暂不输出；请在 issue 里附 iPhone 机型、App 与 Unreal 版本。

en.summary: Unreal LiveLink Face (iPhone) over UDP big-endian floats — no VRCFT needed.
en.description: Reads LiveLink Face packets on port 11111, parses the trailing 244 bytes as big-endian floats and outputs Unified Expressions shapes, eye openness and per-eye gaze. The field table follows the upstream order and rejects a whole frame when the parsed count doesn't match, so misaligned fields never silently become wrong shapes. Variable-length headers, short packets and NaNs are handled explicitly. Real eye angles override the inferred direction when present (confidence 0.85). Head pose is parsed but not emitted yet (units and axes unconfirmed). **Community-untested.**
en.usage: 1. In LiveLink Face on your iPhone, point at this PC's LAN address (port 11111). 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking — same port. 3. Enable LiveLink as a startup instance and restart the engine. 4. Untested: head pose is intentionally not emitted; please include iPhone model and App/Unreal versions in issues.

modules.name: PlayStation VR2
modules.summary: PS VR2 眼动，走本地 TCP 3364 向 PSVR2 Toolkit 取数，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 线格式按上游 C# 的 Marshal.SizeOf 实测还原：帧头 8 字节（u16 类型 + 2 字节填充 + i32 长度），握手与结果同样含填充，眼追回包 v2=76 / v1=66 字节。上游无断线重连（掉线后一直返回旧帧），本模块加 0.5s→10s 退避重连与限频告警。gazeDirNorm 的 z 极化未确认，按 Unity +Z 前映射并带 fail-safe：不指向 -Z 半空间就丢弃。
modules.usage: 1. 装 PSVR2 驱动与 PlayStation VR2 Toolkit 的 DriverEx 并启用眼动。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking。3. 设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：极化、DriverEx 并发、丢追踪时的回包形态。

en.summary: PlayStation VR2 eye tracking over the local TCP 3364 toolkit bridge — no VRCFT.
en.description: Wire format restored from the upstream C# Marshal.SizeOf: 8-byte headers (u16 type, 2 padding, i32 length), padded handshake and result payloads, eye replies 76 bytes on v2 and 66 on v1. Upstream never reconnects and keeps serving stale frames, so this adds 0.5s→10s backoff with throttled warnings. The z polarity is unconfirmed: mapped as Unity +Z-forward with a fail-safe that drops rays outside the -Z half-space.
en.usage: 1. Install the PSVR2 driver plus Toolkit DriverEx and enable eye tracking. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking. 3. Enable the module and restart the engine. 4. Untested: polarity, concurrent connections, packets when tracking is lost.

modules.name: Project Babble
modules.summary: Project Babble / Baballonia 摄像头面捕，直接读 OSC，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 接收 Baballonia 的 OSC over UDP 输出（默认 127.0.0.1:8888），支持单消息与 #bundle 分包。45 条面部地址映射到 Unified Expressions；眼通道是 Baballonia 独有的 PascalCase /LeftEyeX、/LeftEyeY、/LeftEyeLid 等 6 条。归档的 VRCFT-Babble 并不发送这些眼地址，因此本模块以活跃上游 Baballonia 为准，风险已在仓库 README 说明。头姿与瞳孔不提供。
modules.usage: 1. 在 Baballonia 里启用 VRCFT / OSC 输出，目标填本机地址与端口 8888。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking 避免抢端口。3. 在「模块」页设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：眼动地址的极化仅由代码推断，gaze 置信度压到 0.5，请真机确认。

en.summary: Project Babble / Baballonia webcam tracking over OSC — no VRCFT needed.
en.description: Reads Baballonia's OSC-over-UDP output (127.0.0.1:8888 by default) including #bundle splitting. 45 face addresses map onto Unified Expressions; the eye channel uses Baballonia's own PascalCase addresses (/LeftEyeX, /LeftEyeY, /LeftEyeLid, ...). The archived VRCFT-Babble module never sent those eye addresses, so this follows the active upstream and the risk is documented in the repo README. No head pose, no pupil.
en.usage: 1. Enable VRCFT / OSC output in Baballonia, pointed at this PC on port 8888. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking (same port). 3. Enable the module and restart the engine. 4. Untested: eye address polarity is inferred from code only, confidence capped at 0.5 — please confirm on hardware.

modules.name: Varjo Eye Tracking
modules.summary: Varjo 头显的设备级眼追，运行时加载 VarjoLib，不需要 VRCFT。
modules.description: 经 Varjo 原生 C API 读注视与睁眼度/瞳孔。厂商头文件不入库，只按 SDK 4.16.0 声明用到的最小原型并运行时动态加载 VarjoLib.dll（varjo.dll 是 2.x 旧名）；官方注明 GetGazeData 需要 Varjo Base Pro，拿不到时自动降级为只出注视；左手系 +Z 前翻成 ABI 的 -Z 前。
modules.usage: 1. 装 Varjo Base 并完成眼动校准。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking。3. 设为启动，gaze 给渲染、eyes 给头像。4. 未验证：真机极化与无 Pro 时的失败形态。

en.summary: Device-level eye tracking for Varjo headsets, loading VarjoLib at runtime — no VRCFT.
en.description: Uses Varjo's native C API for gaze, openness and pupil. No vendor headers are vendored: only minimal prototypes against SDK 4.16.0, loaded at runtime (varjo.dll is the legacy name). GetGazeData is Pro-only per the docs, so the module degrades to gaze-only when unavailable, and Varjo's left-handed +Z frame is flipped to -Z forward.
en.usage: 1. Install Varjo Base and calibrate. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking. 3. Enable the module; gaze to rendering, eyes to the avatar. 4. Untested: polarity and the failure mode without Pro.
